div.p: Source version and legal-effect provenance — what the source reports vs what Judit independently consumed

g.text: C. Independent consumption (not implied by B)

div.p: Do not assume completeness. A revised manifestation means the publisher labelled the text revised. It does not prove Judit reconstructed every amendment or that outstanding effects were cleared.

text.tspan: [DET] Affecting instrument named by the source

div.p: Explained by source_effect.assess_independent_consumption (visible in Why panel for relevant effects).

g.text: revised manifestation ≠ Judit independently applied every amendment
source-effect annotation ≠ independently consumed affecting instrument
consumed affecting instrument ≠ verified amendment application
